title: the launcher line is allowed when the launcher path, or the brief path, holds a space and is written as one single-quoted word
source: intended: a binary installed under a folder with a space (for example a macOS Application Support path) must still launch
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-9, quoted words). The dispatcher prompt renders the launcher as a single-quoted word when its path holds a space, and the guard must allow that exact line: the first word as one quoted word whose real path is this executable, and the value after --brief as one quoted word. A quoted word holds plain characters and single spaces only, and holds at least one space (quotes appear only where a space needs them). The launcher in the first row is a symlink inside a folder with a space that points at the implementation under test, so the guard must compare real paths. The launcher line carries `--build` (build vocabulary, defect N-10; docs/decisions.md D6). Since N-29 every line also carries --worktree path:<primary>, and the hook step sets JITSO_PROJECT.
